name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd, HER2-directed ADC)
cyclesNote: every 3 weeks until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Physician determined.

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: T-DXd is moderately-to-highly emetogenic; give prophylaxis before each dose.

supportiveCare: Educate patient on respiratory symptoms; interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis is a class risk.
monitoring: Interstitial lung disease surveillance: assess for cough, dyspnea, fever; hold and evaluate promptly if suspected.
CBC before each cycle; LVEF at baseline and periodically.
Response assessment by imaging every 2 to 3 cycles.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan
drugs.notes: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg IV on day 1 every 3 weeks. HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate for HER2-positive/HER2-expressing uterine serous carcinoma progressing after a chemotherapy-plus-trastuzumab first line (tumor-agnostic HER2 activity). Hold and evaluate for any suspected interstitial lung disease. Dose scaled by body weight (engine multiplies by kg). Author's own wording; general reference NCCN / DeVita.
